newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle market quiet, no sales - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle market quiet, no sales - USDA.

text.p: DODGE CITY, July 14 (Reuder) - Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said. Inquiry moderate, demand light.
Confirmed - none Last week - 7,600 Last year - none
Wk to date - 3,800 Last week - 11,700 Last year - 3,400

Sales confirmed for the week to date on 3,800 cattle, mostly previously contracted or formulated cattle. Asking prices $64.00-$66.00, mostly $64.00-$65.00 per cwt, bids $62.00. Last sales at $62.00 Friday.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
